verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is open-source and self-hostable, giving users control over their own infrastructure and database (docs-9, docs-30, docs-38), and tasks are plain code with no proprietary DSL (docs-34), which supports portability. However, there is no documented explicit 'export all data' feature, data-export API, or migration tooling for leaving the hosted service. missing for 10: explicit data export/backup feature, documented export formats, independent confirmation of successful full data migration off the platform.
